sites.note: Operating refinery complex (Reliance Industries). Wikipedia centre point is ~1-2 km from the process area, hence the larger radius. Needs a human SWIR/imagery spot-check.

sites.note: Integrated steel plant with blast furnaces, operating since 1955. Needs a human imagery spot-check.

sites.name: Rourkela Steel Plant (SAIL)
sites.note: Integrated steel plant, continuous hot-metal production. Needs a human imagery spot-check.

sites.name: Gujarat Refinery, Koyali (IOCL)
sites.note: Operating refinery since 1965. Only a few days with detections in the window.

sites.name: Paradip Refinery (IOCL)

sites.name: Jharia coalfield underground fires
sites.note: Coal-seam fires burning since 1916 and still active per the cited article; non-industrial persistent heat. Area also contains mining, so a nearby detection is not guaranteed to be a seam fire.

caveats: Small verified set (n=6); per-class figures are indicative, not statistically robust.
Thresholds were set a priori (src/lib/classify/config.ts); tuning on this set would inflate these numbers.
Sites with no VIIRS detection on the chosen date are excluded, not counted as correct.
Verified classes come from external evidence recorded per site (evidenceUrl/verifiedBy). Rows marked "documentary" rest on facility records only, not on imagery of the detection itself.
A documented continuously-operating plant does not prove a given day's detection was routine; use the industrial-vs-other figure as the fair comparison for those rows.
